scenes.hook: You unlock your phone with your face. A passkey can let you sign in the same way.
scenes.idea: Instead of typing a password, your device uses a cryptographic key to prove the sign-in is yours.
scenes.demo: The website sends a challenge. You approve with your fingerprint, face scan, or device pin.
scenes.compare: The site receives a signed response, not your fingerprint. Passkeys are designed to resist phishing.
scenes.takeaway: Recovery still matters. Check how your account restores access if your device is lost.
scenes.close: Would you try a passkey? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
